purpose: Single source of truth for navigation. Implement every control below exactly. Control labels match the visible text or the accessible name; the prototype matches by prefix.
history: Back and BACK mean: return to the previous screen in the history stack.

special_destinations.BACK: Return to the previous screen in the navigation history.
special_destinations.FROM: Setup finished or skipped. If the previous screen is 39 (My items), return to 39. Otherwise go to 22 (Home).
special_destinations.MULTI: Go to 52 if several categories are chosen (the prototype uses: More categories was opened). Otherwise go to 36.
special_destinations.ADD: Start the add-debt flow (flow=add_debt) and go to 17.
special_destinations.ADDP: Start the add-debt-for-a-person flow (flow=add_debt_person) and go to 53.
special_destinations.NEXT17: If flow=add_debt go to 53. Otherwise (a sale on credit) go to 18.
special_destinations.NEXT53: Apply the inheritance rule: if the person has no balance, or no due date and no plan, go to 18. Otherwise go to 31 and show the inherited terms. (The prototype uses flow=add_debt_person to decide; the brief's inheritance rule is the real rule.)
special_destinations.MOMO: Start a MoMo payment from the current screen. Remember the origin screen. Always go to 61 (never block the sale on setup).
special_destinations.MOMO16: Done on 16, in this order: (1) parts must sum to the total; (2) if a MoMo part exists, confirm it (Direct: 62; Phone request: 56 then 57, setup via 60 if needed); (3) commit once; (4) go to 30. If the request fails go to 59 and keep the draft on 16. Same order, lock and leave question (decided 11 Nov 2026) on the collect split 27 (also when opened from 19) and on 19's own MoMo choice: Direct on 61 returns unconfirmed; 62 opens only at Received (27) or Save plan (19); money confirmed on 62 is locked if the save then fails; leaving a draft that holds received MoMo asks the leave question. Back from 16 opened from 55 keeps the parts the same way as from 15. Leave on Back with received MoMo goes: from 16 to an empty 15, from 27 to Home, from 19 to an empty 15 (Home for a manual debt). While 19 holds received MoMo, Next cycle is disabled (choosing it would drop the money) and the payment-recorded panel shows "Received" with a green check or "not confirmed yet" under each part.
special_destinations.MOMO27: Received on 27: if a MoMo part exists, run the MoMo request for that part (56) before recording the collection. Otherwise go to 28.
special_destinations.SEND: Send the request to Paystack. If the charge asks for a code (status send_otp), go to 58. Otherwise go to 57. (The prototype goes to 58 only when Telecel is chosen.)
special_destinations.MOMOOK: From 62: the merchant confirms the money arrived (recorded 'MoMo · you confirmed'). From the Paystack flow: charge confirmed (recorded 'MoMo · verified'). Go to 30 for a sale (15, 55, 16) or 28 for a collection (25, 26, 27). From 19: continue the plan commit (31, or 16 in flow=split).
special_destinations.PAYOTHER: Return to the origin screen so the merchant can choose another payment method.
special_destinations.CANCELMOMO: Cancel the pending request and return to the origin screen.
special_destinations.SAVEMOMO: Save the payout account and create or update the Paystack subaccount. If the merchant arrived by tapping MoMo, continue to 56. Otherwise return to the previous screen.
special_destinations.DIRECT: From 61: go to 62. Needs no setup beyond the merchant's own MoMo number. Records the MoMo part as 'you confirmed'.
special_destinations.PHONE: From 61: if the Paystack payout account is not set up go to 60 (Save and verify continues to 56); otherwise go to 56.
special_destinations.MOMOPICK: MoMo tile on 16 (split): first ask how much (amount editor prefilled with Left to pay, can be lowered), then go to 61 with pick16 set and that amount. DIRECT or PHONE then records the method on the MoMo part and returns to 16. With a direct MoMo row already present, the tile raises it and only the extra goes to 61/62. Nothing is requested yet.
special_destinations.SAVECREDIT: Save on 18 or 19. If flow=split, mark the Owe part complete and return to 16 (drop the screens in between from history). Otherwise go to 31.
special_destinations.SAVE19: Save plan on 19. If today's payment includes MoMo: confirm it first (Direct: 62; Phone request: 56 then 57, 60 for setup, 61 when the method is not chosen yet). Then commit once (debt or sale credit, plan, collection of the amount paid today) and go to 31. In flow=split return to 16 with the Owe part complete. If the request fails go to 59 and stay on 19, nothing saved.
special_destinations.MOMOPICK19: MoMo on 19: go to 61 with pick19 set. The chosen method returns to 19.

rules: A MoMo row whose money has been received is locked (decided 11 Nov 2026): when the phone request is verified, or the owner has tapped "Money received" on 62 for a Direct MoMo, the row cannot be edited or removed. If a later step fails and the draft returns to 16, the locked rows stay locked. Cash is never locked. If a locked MoMo row exists and the owner leaves the draft (Cancel sale on 59, header Home, or another tab), ask first: "GH₵{amount} MoMo was already received and will not be recorded. Leave anyway?" with Stay (default) and Leave. Back from 16 (the on-screen Back and the phone back button) behaves like leaving the draft when a locked MoMo row exists: it asks the same question and only goes to 15 if the owner chooses Leave, in which case the whole draft, including the split parts, is discarded. Never go back to 15 with received money still held in a hidden draft. With no locked row, Back goes to 15 and keeps the split parts in 15's route parameters, so tapping Split payment again reopens 16 with the same Cash, MoMo and Owe parts; if the amount on 15 was changed meanwhile (the total no longer matches the parts) the parts are cleared and 16 starts again with the new total. The draft is cleared as before by Done, header Home or another tab. A Direct MoMo pick is NOT confirmed when it is chosen: it returns to 16 as "not confirmed yet" and is confirmed on 62 only after Done, as in MOMO16.

Where Done ends (decided 11 Nov 2026): after the sale is saved, if any money was received today (a Cash or MoMo part above zero) go to 30 Sale recorded, which lists each paid part and a line "{Name} still owes GH₵x" for the owed part. If nothing was received today (the whole sale is owed, so the only part is Owe) go to 31 Saved as credit, the same as a plain credit sale from 15. The draft survives Menu > Settings > Back; header Home discards it.

Paying today panel with one method (decided 12 Nov 2026): the panel is shown whenever Amount paid today is above zero and a method is chosen, also for Cash only or MoMo only (one row, then Total today, then the pink Still owed row). wide_layout.keyboard_and_mouse: On Sell the amount can be typed on the keyboard (digits, Backspace) and Enter is Done; on a result screen Enter is New sale; Escape closes a dialog. No single-letter shortcuts. Every control has a visible focus ring (3px #0F172A outline with a 2px offset) and a hover state (slightly darker border or background). Tab order follows the reading order.
wide_layout.sizes: Touch targets stay 48px or taller on every width, because counter tablets are used by touch. Body text 17px or larger; page titles 30px; money in columns uses equal-width digits (tabular-nums) and is right-aligned. Cards keep the phone style: white, 2px #CBD5E1 border, 20px radius.
wide_layout.testing: Check 768x1024, 1024x768, 1280x800 and 1440x900 in addition to 340, 360 and 393px. No horizontal scroll, no clipped amount (GH₵12,345.00), no wrapped button label.
wide_layout.same_as_phone: Wide screens change layout only. Every control, label, rule, destination, validation, money calculation and saved record is the one defined for that screen in this file; nothing in wide_layout overrides a screen's own rules. A control that exists on the phone screen must exist on the wide screen with the same label and accessible name, except: (a) Menu (23), the header Home button, the bottom bar and the Done button on Settings are replaced by the sidebar; (b) Back is not shown on Home, Owed, Today's transactions, My money, Items and Settings, because the sidebar reaches them, and is kept on every task column; (c) on Owed the per-row Collect, WhatsApp and Call buttons move to the selected person's detail; (d) 20 and 55 are shown together. Flags behave the same (receipts, subscription, phone request).
wide_layout.icons: Every payment choice shows its icon with its label on every screen and width: Cash (note), MoMo (phone), Owe (person), Split payment (cash + phone + person where Owe can be part of the split, as on 15, 55 and 16; cash + phone where only Cash and MoMo are possible, as on 19, 26 and 27). A label is never shown without its icon.
wide_layout.approved_additions: Approved by the owner on 14 Nov 2026 (build everything, no temporary fix). These four are the ONLY content added on wide screens and each is a read-only view of data the app already stores; none creates a record, a rule or a money calculation. (1) Sell with items is one screen on wide layouts (20 and 55 together); the phone keeps two screens. (2) 'Last sale' box on Sell: the most recent saved sale today, showing its amount (formatGhs), method (Cash, MoMo, Split or On credit) and time; hidden when there is no sale today; not tappable. (3) 'Collect first' on Home: up to two people with the largest late balances, most late first (same order as the phone tile), each with its due tag, amount and Collect, WhatsApp and Call (Call only with a valid number); hidden when nobody owes. (4) Person column in Today's transactions: the customer's name in Title Case (displayName), a dash when there is none. The wide-layout test must assert that each addition reads from the same source as the phone and changes no stored value.

rules_global.menu_drawer: The menu is a left drawer over the current page, never a separate page. Header Menu button at the left (see 23). It adds no history entry and keeps drafts. Back from a destination chosen in the drawer returns to the page the drawer was opened from.
rules_global.header_always_visible: The header (Menu button or home tile, shop name, connection status) is fixed at the top of the screen on every screen and at every width while the content scrolls beneath it (decided 14 Nov 2026 from a phone test where the Menu button was out of sight on a long Home). It keeps the safe-area inset and the 3px bottom border, sits above content and below the Menu drawer and dialogs, and is never hidden or moved by scrolling or by the virtual keyboard. There is no hide-on-scroll behaviour.
